title: QuestAppQuestRequest
description: quest.app-quest-request@1: PUT /api/v1/app-quests/:slug on OpenVibe.Quest with an app token (capability quest.app_quest.manage). A developer app defines a quest on its own project's events: each step counts events of type app.<project_key>.<name> whose envelope actor is a person (the app publishing on_behalf_of them). The badge is the only reward: app quests never pay OpenCoins. Only production apps' events are counted (Events never hands sandbox events to first-party consumers).

event_type.description: One of the app's own event types (app.<project_key>.<name>), as it publishes them at OpenVibe.Events.

url.description: Where a person does the steps: the app's own page.

status.description: retired: kept with its completions and badges, no longer counted or listed. Default active.
